title: SEED WebShop source-faithful reproduction: frozen OpenEvo SD-LoRA vs BASE under corrected task semantics
objective: Re-answer the existing BASE-vs-frozen-OpenEvo held-out question on a source-faithful first-validation semantic panel derived from pinned public SEED code, without retraining either arm.
scientific_question: On the source-faithful first-validation semantic panel derived from pinned public SEED code, does the already-frozen OpenEvo SD-LoRA policy improve WebShop performance relative to its paired BASE policy under one identical parser-compatible measurement contract?

benchmark.name: WebShop small (source-faithful first-validation panel)
benchmark.task_semantics: Per-slot worker seeds Python random, loads products, constructs synthetic goals (which consume random via price-range sampling), re-seeds with the same worker_seed, then shuffles before reset(session=sampled_session_index) selects the task. This matches pinned SEED SimServer.__init__. A numeric session index alone is not a complete task identity.

primary.name: repaired-PRIMARY parser-compatible identical-across-arms inference contract
primary.history: SimpleMemory format [Observation n: 'obs', Action n: 'act']; records are (pre-step reformatted obs, projected action); history_length=2
primary.parser: v3 action-command recovery: strict parse first; if it fails, recover the first well-formed (search|click|select|buy)[...] command after </think> and re-wrap as <think>...</think>\n<action>cmd</action> so strict re-parse succeeds. Invalid/unparseable actions are passed through to the environment (no substitution/repair), identical across BASE and OPEN_EVO_SD.
primary.top_k: disabled (HF neutralized to vocab_size 151936 to match vLLM top_k=-1)
primary.generation_seed: 2026082500 + panel_ordinal (frozen, identical across arms for the same slot); per-step + step_index
primary.evaluator: WebShop raw task_score (continuous, terminal) + exact success (won == done and task_score==1.0), saved separately

strict_seed_parser.parser: webshop_projection verbatim; PASS-THROUGH (invalid projected action sent to env, no substitution/repair)
strict_seed_parser.note: Do not rerun an entire strict-parser panel merely to reproduce an already-established 0/0 wrapper failure.

task_selection.selection_basis: SEED first-validation draw (env.seed+1000); draw order preserved as panel order; each slot interpreted within its own worker-shuffled goal list
task_selection.label: source-faithful SEED WebShop first-validation 128-slot semantic panel

superseded_manifest.reason: Builder omitted the second random.seed(worker_seed) before shuffle that pinned SEED SimServer performs after get_synthetic_goals; fixed in builder commit 12034fde3c7c8506b25d0bbbdfe0b3afc12f3bec.

analysis.primary_estimand: OPEN_EVO_SD minus BASE paired contrast on identical source-faithful task identities

resources.gpu_model: single GPU per arm; the two arms may run in parallel on two authorized live-idle GPUs
resources.authorized_gpu_uuids_source: parent experiment-execution-policy.md standing RTX 5090 pool intersected with immediate live-idle at launch

tracking.offline_fallback: only after saved online probe failure and final spool hash
